topic: Data reprocessing and bug fix status
summary_markdown:

It was noted that after fixing the data, it will be necessary to ask AFA and JCDecaux (for other countries) to re-fetch the data. Finally, [me] confirmed that the data had been reprocessed, uploaded, and the bug fixed.
